### Compatibility

Mirrors renderPreferenceSummaryBadge over renderBadgePrimitive with default variant preference and default label Preferences: the label reads label/text/namespace/value in that order, the status reads status/state/version, and both are exposed as data-badge-status and data-badge-variant on the governed Badge substrate; tone and emphasis retain their shared Badge behaviour. versionField lowers to version; namespacesField is consumed and left unbound because the renderer reads a scalar namespace alias while the field is the preference_namespaces array.
